$comment: This extension implements succession rules derived from Islamic law as codified in specific jurisdictions. The extension name references the legal tradition, not the personal religious beliefs of any individual. A person of any faith (or none) may be subject to these rules depending on their jurisdiction of domicile. Extension type values: x-inherit-nikah-nama (document), x-inherit-waqfiyyah (document), x-inherit-waqf (trust), x-inherit-wasiyya (bequest), x-inherit-sadaqah-jariyah (bequest), x-inherit-halachic-yerusha is NOT from this extension.
title: Islamic Succession Extension
description: Faraid (Islamic inheritance) rules: heir classification, fixed shares, residuary (asaba), awl/radd adjustments, wasiyya limits, iddah periods, waqf details, and priority debts including mahr.
dataProvenance: Quranic inheritance verses (Surah An-Nisa 4:11-12), classical fiqh (Hanafi, Shafi'i, Maliki, Hanbali schools)

heirClass.$comment: son: ibn. daughter: bint. father: ab. mother: umm. grandfather: jadd sahih (true/paternal grandfather). grandmother: jaddah sahihah. brother_full: akh shaqiq. brother_paternal: akh li-ab (consanguine). brother_maternal: akh li-umm (uterine). sister_full: ukht shaqiqah. sister_paternal: ukht li-ab. sister_maternal: ukht li-umm. husband: zawj. wife: zawja. son_of_son: ibn al-ibn. daughter_of_son: bint al-ibn. uncle_paternal: amm shaqiq (full paternal uncle, asaba rank 9). uncle_paternal_half: amm li-ab (consanguine paternal uncle, asaba rank 10). nephew_brother_full: ibn al-akh al-shaqiq (son of full brother, asaba rank 7). nephew_brother_paternal: ibn al-akh li-ab (son of consanguine brother, asaba rank 8). cousin_paternal_full: ibn amm shaqiq (son of full paternal uncle, asaba rank 11). cousin_paternal_half: ibn amm li-ab (son of consanguine paternal uncle, asaba rank 12). Full asaba hierarchy: 1-son, 2-son's son, 3-father, 4-true grandfather, 5-full brother, 6-consanguine brother, 7-son of full brother, 8-son of consanguine brother, 9-full paternal uncle, 10-consanguine paternal uncle, 11-son of full paternal uncle, 12-son of consanguine paternal uncle, 13-15 ascending paternal uncles. Maternal uncle (khal), paternal aunt (amma), maternal aunt (khala) are dhawu al-arham — model with core uncle_aunt kinship type + lineage property, not as heirClass values. Under Jafari (Shia) law, maternal uncle/aunt are Class 3 heirs with equal standing.

fixedShareFraction.$comment: Quranic fixed share as a fraction, e.g. 1/6, 1/8, 2/3.

blockedBy.$comment: personId of the heir who blocks this heir.

asabaRank.description: Position in the residuary (asaba) heir hierarchy, 1-15. Rank 1 (son) completely excludes all lower ranks. Only applicable when residuaryClass is asaba_by_self
asabaRank.$comment: 1: son. 2: son's son (however far down). 3: father. 4: true grandfather (however far up). 5: full brother. 6: consanguine brother. 7: son of full brother. 8: son of consanguine brother. 9: full paternal uncle. 10: consanguine paternal uncle. 11: son of full paternal uncle. 12: son of consanguine paternal uncle. 13-15: ascending paternal uncles and their sons

toNonHeirsOnly.$comment: Whether wasiyya is restricted to non-heirs only.

requiresHeirConsent.$comment: Whether bequests exceeding the limit or to heirs require heir consent.

waqfId.$comment: Reference to Trust.id for the waqf entity.

school.$comment: Islamic school of jurisprudence (madhab) governing succession.

faraidApplies.$comment: Whether faraid (compulsory Islamic inheritance) applies to this estate.

awlApplied.$comment: Whether awl (proportional reduction) was applied when fixed shares exceed the estate.

raddApplied.$comment: Whether radd (proportional increase) was applied when fixed shares are less than the estate.

willDateHijri.$comment: Hijri date of the will, if applicable.

mahr.description: Mahr — the Islamic marriage gift obligation. A debt owed by the deceased to the surviving spouse. Takes priority over other debts and succession distribution
mahr.$comment: Al Rayan Bank-requested: mahr is a significant financial obligation in Islamic estate administration. Already modellable via priorityDebts with type=mahr, but a dedicated field enables direct access and richer metadata

amount.description: Mahr amount in minor currency units

agreed.description: Whether the mahr amount was agreed and documented

paidInFull.description: Whether the mahr has been paid in full during the marriage

outstandingAmount.description: Outstanding (unpaid) mahr amount in minor currency units

creditorPersonId.description: Reference to the Person.id of the spouse to whom the mahr is owed

documentRef.description: Reference to the nikah contract or other document recording the mahr
